description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationService class in the OrangeHRM application, specifically testing methods such as getLocationById, searchLocations, getSearchLocationListCount, getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation, getLocationIdsForEmployees, and getAccessibleLocationsArray. It uses PHPUnit framework for testing and mocks dependencies like LocationDao, NormalizerService, EmployeeService, and managers to verify the behavior of LocationService.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing LocationService methods using PHPUnit, including setup of dependencies, mocking DAO interactions, and verifying method functionality.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates mock objects for dependencies, and configures the service container.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationById returns the correct Location object for a given ID.

methods.name: testSearchLocations
methods.description: Verifies searching locations with filter parameters returns the expected list.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Checks that getSearchLocationListCount returns the correct count for filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Tests that getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation returns expected number for a location ID.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Verifies that getLocationIdsForEmployees returns correct location IDs for a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Tests the behavior of getAccessibleLocationsArray with different parameters.
